name: gasket
title: Gasket
description: For an independent garage or MOT station: the phone number pressed in heavy black characters on a full-size white number plate with a blue band, every price on a small plate of its own, on tyre black by night and workshop-floor grey by day under a tyre-black header, with a strip of tyre tread as the only rule.

tokens.--font-plate: number-plate lettering, fixed-pitch, heavy and in capitals: plates, headings, the business name, the menu, labels, the name under a quote, and code
tokens.--font-body: body text and the supplier line under the number on the big plate
tokens.--text-s: small text: the menu, labels, table headings, dates, the back link, page links, the footer
tokens.--text-m: base body size, the business name in the footer, third-level headings, and figures on plates in tables
tokens.--text-l: the business name in the header, the standfirst under a page title and a customer's words
tokens.--text-h: section headings in page text and the name of each job in a list
tokens.--text-plate: lettering on a price plate in a list; the price plate on a service page and the big phone plate scale up from it
tokens.--text-band: the word on a plate's blue band and the supplier line under the number on the big plate
tokens.--tracking: letter spacing of headings, capital labels and plate lettering
tokens.--color-bg: page background (tyre black; workshop-floor grey by day), the grooves of the tread band, and the inner ring of the keyboard focus outline
tokens.--color-panel: the bars behind table rows, list entries and checklist lines, and the ground of quotes and code
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, labels, table headings and links, and the outer ring of the keyboard focus outline
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: dates, the back link, descriptions in lists, the name under a quote
tokens.--color-accent: plate-band blue: the band at the left of every plate, link underlines, the marker beside the current menu item, list bullets, checklist ticks and the selection highlight (by day one blue that holds on both the grey floor and the black header)
tokens.--color-on-accent: the word and the ring printed on a plate's blue band, and selected text
tokens.--color-tread: the blocks and the centre rib of the tyre-tread band
tokens.--color-tyre: the header and the footer, tyre black by night and by day
tokens.--color-on-tyre: text and links on the header and footer: the business name, the menu, the footer's contact line
tokens.--color-on-tyre-muted: secondary text on the footer: the service links and the footer note
tokens.--plate: the face of every plate: the phone number, prices, figures in right-aligned table columns, and the skip link
tokens.--plate-edge: the keyline round a plate (the plate's own white at night, black by day)
tokens.--keyline: thickness of the keyline round the phone plate, price plates and plate cells in tables
tokens.--plate-width: widest the big phone-number plate may get, and the width of its column beside the page title on wide screens
tokens.--plate-cell: width of a plate in a table column: room for a ten-character figure on one line (a longer one wraps and the plate grows taller)
tokens.--band-width: narrowest the blue band may be: its width on table figures and on the marker beside the current menu item (a band that carries a word grows to fit it)
tokens.--tread-height: height of the tread band under the header, above the footer and wherever the text has a divider; its blocks, grooves and rib scale with it
tokens.--measure: widest a column of text may get: page text, the standfirst, descriptions in lists (tables, dividers and the checklist run on to the page edge on wide screens)
tokens.--label-col: width of the left-hand column that holds section headings on wide screens
tokens.--gutter: space between the page and the edge of the screen
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between table rows, list entries, checklist lines and the lines under the phone plate
tokens.--space-2: small gap: padding inside table cells, under headings, between a label and its value
tokens.--space-3: standard gap: between paragraphs and menu links, between a label and its value under the phone plate, padding inside list entries, quotes and code
tokens.--space-4: gap between sections, between the heading column and the text, and above the page title
tokens.--space-5: gap between the page title and the plate beside it, and the space at the foot of the page
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of bars, list entries, quotes, code and images
tokens.--focus-width: thickness of each ring of the keyboard focus outline
tokens.--tap: smallest height of anything meant to be tapped: menu links, the back link, page links
